capabilities: Add typed tasks to daily notes via a role → project → type toolbar
Sort task lists by role, project, due date and created date
Render tasks as colored role, project and type badges
Show progress with a Today panel, role dividers and filters
Track tasks, time periods and timesheets in a dashboard
disambiguation: Not general PhD thesis management; it only organizes tasks, time tracking and progress from daily notes.
extras: Listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Roles and projects are stored in a roles-projects-themes.json file that stays in sync with settings and can be edited as code.
intentEvidence: Every role, project and type is pushed into Custom Badges as a badge
problem: Obsidian task lists have no built-in way to group tasks by role and project, order them by role/due/created date, or render typed metadata as colored badges.

relations.evidence: Every role, project and type is pushed into Custom Badges as a badge
Due date is the Tasks plugin's 📅 YYYY-MM-DD
It runs automatically when a new daily note is created (after Rollover adds yesterday's tasks

summary: Task manager that adds role- and project-typed tasks from daily notes, sorts them, and renders them as colored Custom Badges.
